scope: Bounded 2-epoch label-budget study on full 2016-2017 training; evaluate 2018 only
consistency: symmetric Bernoulli KL on unlabeled train rows under independent dropout; temperature=1, no pseudo-labels
selection: Fixed final epoch; all seeds, mean ensemble; no epoch/seed search
limits: Short bounded budget; negative finding does not exclude benefits from other budgets
At 100% labels, consistency term is zero
Mask stratification uses train labels only; actual exposed counts reported
architecture: Retain all 12 numerical features and trainable MCC/channel branch in ALL variants; B1 adds trainable joint32, B2 adds frozen semantic32, B3 adds projected semantic32
prior_pilot: Replacement-encoding pilot retained in runs/semantic-e1-v1 and incomplete runs/semantic-e3-v1; not the formal PRD result
